target.title: fix(agent): return data URIs for workspace-relative identity card avatars (#97602)
target.body: ## Summary `agent.identity.get` returned inline data URIs for workspace-relative avatars, but the **Control UI Personal card** is initialized from the **bootstrap config** (`control-ui-config.json`), which still mapped workspace avatars through `resolveAssistantAvatarUrl` to the auth-gated `/avatar/` route. An `` tag cannot carry a Bearer header, so the linked Personal-card 401/broken-image symptom persisted despite the RPC fix. This PR consolidates the workspace-safe avatar reader into **one shared, gateway-internal helper** (`readLocalAvatarDataUrl` in `session-utils.ts`) and uses it in **both** projections — `agent.identity.get` and the bootstrap config handler — so identity and bootstrap produce identical inline data URIs. Remote HTTP URLs, existing data URLs, text fallbacks, and the `/avatar/` HTTP endpoint are unchanged. The helper is **not** re-exported on the Plugin SDK surface (`session-utils.ts` is gateway-internal; the `identity-avatar` barrel does not re-export it). The workspace root is canonicalised with `realpathSync` to keep the containment check correct for symlinked workspaces. Fixes #97602. ## What Problem This Solves The Personal card in Control UI showed a broken avatar image because its avatar comes from the bootstrap config, not from `agent.identity.get`: - UI chat avatar → `agent.identity.get` (already fixed in the first revision). - **Config Personal card** → `appConfig.assistantIdentity.avatar` → bootstrap `control-ui-config.json` → `/avatar/` (auth-gated → `` 401). **This PR fixes this path.** Given a workspace with an avatar file `avatar.png`: - **Before**: bootstrap `assistantAvatar` = `/avatar/main` (route URL → `` 401) - **After**: bootstrap `assistantAvatar` = `data:image/png;base64,...` (inline → renders) ## Why This Change Was Made ClawSweeper's P1: the earlier fix covered only `agent.identity.get`, leaving the bootstrap Personal-card path emitting the protected route. Rather than duplicate a third avatar reader, this revision lands **one canonical projection**: 1. `readLocalAvatarDataUrl(filePath, workspaceDir)` moves from `agent.ts` into `session-utils.ts` (exported gateway-internal, off the SDK barrel). 2. `agent.identity.get` imports the shared helper (behaviour unchanged). 3. The bootstrap config handler resolves the avatar via the same `resolveAgentAvatar(...)` and, when `kind === "local"`, inlines the file with the shared helper before `resolveAssistantAvatarUrl` (which passes data URIs through untouched). On any failure it falls back to the route URL. ## Changes - `src/gateway/session-utils.ts`: add exported gateway-internal `readLocalAvatarDataUrl` (shared reader). - `src/gateway/server-methods/agent.ts`: import the shared helper; remove the now-duplicated private copy and its now-unused imports. - `src/gateway/control-ui.ts`: inline workspace-local avatars as data URIs in the bootstrap config response. - `src/gateway/control-ui.http.test.ts`: bootstrap-config regression test asserting a workspace-local avatar is returned as a data URI (not `/avatar/main`). ## Evidence **1. Bootstrap regression test (new) + identity/list regressions — all green** ``` node vitest run src/gateway/control-ui.http.test.ts \ src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts \ src/agents/identity-avatar.test.ts \ src/gateway/session-utils.test.ts -t "avatar|identity" Test Files 10 passed (10) Tests 77 passed | 898 skipped (975) ``` The new test `inlines a workspace-local assistant avatar as a data URI in bootstrap config (#97602)` fails on the pre-fix bootstrap handler and passes after. **2. Real behavior proof — standalone harness driving the real `handleControlUiHttpRequest` bootstrap path** A standalone script (not a committed test) creates a real workspace with a real `avatar.png`, invokes the production bootstrap-config handler, and prints the `assistantAvatar` from the actual JSON response body: ``` ========== BEFORE (PR head control-ui.ts) ========== handled: true assistantAvatar (first 48 chars): "/avatar/main" startsWith 'data:image/png;base64,' -> false contains '/avatar/main' (broken auth-gated route) -> true ========== AFTER (fix) ========== handled: true assistantAvatar (first 48 chars): "data:image/png;base64,YXZhdGFyLWJ5dGVzCg==" startsWith 'data:image/png;base64,' -> true contains '/avatar/main' (broken auth-gated route) -> false ``` **3. Lint:** `oxlint` on the three changed source files — clean (exit 0). ## AI-assisted This PR was AI-assisted (Claude Code). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) Co-Authored-By: Claude
